_comment: Applied after the product-name swap. %NAME% = brand name, %HOST% = hosting company, %UPSTREAM% = upstream name (left as is). `keep`: keys whose upstream name is NOT swapped (credit to the upstream author). `en`: English text replacing upstream's. `fromWebKey`: every locale takes its own translation of upstream's web-edition string (already server-side wording). Every other `en` key is removed from the non-English locales, so they fall back to the corrected English instead of a translated wrong claim ("on this computer", VidBee Cloud sign-in). Translators can add `de`, `ja`, ... maps here.

en.app.description: Download media, transcribe it on %HOST%'s servers, and ask AI
en.about.description: Download media from 1000+ sites, create searchable transcripts, and summarize, translate, or ask questions with AI. Downloads, transcripts and AI all run on %HOST%'s servers. Based on the open-source %UPSTREAM% project (MIT License).

en.settings.downloadPathDescription: Where downloads are saved on %HOST%'s servers
en.settings.autoTranscribeAfterDownloadDesc: When a download finishes, start a transcript on %HOST%'s servers. Files with no speech are skipped. Already queued jobs keep running if you turn this off.
en.settings.maxConcurrentTranscriptionsDesc: How many transcripts can run at the same time on %HOST%'s servers. Lowering this does not stop jobs that are already running.
en.settings.ai.providerDialogDescription: API keys are stored on %HOST%'s servers. Preset providers already have a base URL
en.settings.mcp.accessNote: Keep %NAME% running while connected. Only %HOST%'s server itself can connect. Treat the HTTP configuration as a password; rotating the token revokes saved HTTP configurations.
